route_steps.title: Set up the guild shop, runes and first cash cycle
route_steps.baseline_instruction: Return to the standard spellbook if Desert Treasure left you on Ancient Magicks. High Level Alchemy requires the standard spellbook; switch at the Desert Pyramid altar (or another spellbook switch you have actually unlocked). Go to the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. Entry needs 66 Magic, but your 63 Magic plus a Wizard's mind bomb (+3) is enough. Drink immediately before entering; repeat for a later re-entry if the boost expires. The Guild rune-and-staff shop also requires The Hand in the Sand, finished immediately after Enlightened Journey in 1.4. Buy plain battlestaves from Wizard Akutha's rune-and-staff shop upstairs. It normally stocks five at about 7,000 coins each; hop worlds or return as stock replenishes. Zaff in Varrock is a small supplementary source. Buying five at a time is repetitive: do this in manageable batches, not one uninterrupted 1,590-staff shop-hop/craft/alch session. Audit the nature-rune bank after MTA. The 1,650 bought in 1.3 was MTA opening stock, and MTA consumed many of those runes; it cannot also pay for all 1,590 High Alchemy casts. Each finished staff needs one nature rune. Buy only the live shortfall from this Guild shop (normally 250 in stock) or another accessible nature-rune source, in batches as the staff cycle returns cash. Do not require the full 1,590 in hand before starting. Equip a fire staff or supply fire runes. If your coin pile is small, buy only a few staves, craft and alch them, then recycle the proceeds into the next batch. A finished Earth battlestaff alchs for 9,300 coins; against a roughly 7,000-coin base staff, that is around 2,300 coins returned above the staff cost before rune costs and shop-price variation. Across the full stock, roughly 3.6 million coins of gross spread is a planning estimate, not a guaranteed final cash balance.

route_steps.title: Use mushroom pie until 58 Crafting, then finish without boosts
route_steps.baseline_instruction: Earth battlestaves require 58 Crafting. Read live Crafting XP first. If actual 58+, attach the orbs without a pie. Refresh the pie only while a boost is needed, and check actual XP after each batch rather than assuming a fixed starting level. route_steps.baseline_instruction: This is not an RFD requirement, but the permanent karambwan food loop makes it worth doing before Cooking 70. Start with Timfraku in Tai Bwo Wannai, then help his three sons around Karamja. Pack an agility potion (4)—Tamayu requires the full four-dose item, not merely an available boost—an iron-or-better spear, small fishing net, knife, pestle and mortar, tinderbox, two logs or an axe, jogre bones, seaweed, a banana and Karamjan rum, plus Magic/Ranged gear for a monkey, antipoison and travel supplies. Jogres can supply the bones and sometimes a spear; if needed, an iron spear is sold at the Fortis Blacksmith. Combine the sliced banana with the rum before leaving Karamja. Follow the Wiki's item/order details for the odd recipe chain rather than guessing. Zero-bank potion path and later reservation: at 34+ Herblore, each toadflax + vial of water + toad's legs makes an Agility potion(3). If no toadflax is banked, take 200 coins, food and light gear to the Brimhaven Agility Arena in east Brimhaven. Pay Cap'n Izzy No-Beard to enter, traverse ordinary obstacles to tag the currently lit ticket dispenser, and repeat until you have three Brimhaven vouchers per missing toadflax; Pirate Jackie the Fruit's Agility Arena Store exchanges them for the herb. Each successful tag gives one voucher; there is no seed roll or crop timer. If you prefer passive preparation, a Master Farmer can yield a variable toadflax seed to grow at the disease-free Hosidius herb patch, but that is not the zero-bank fallback. At the Tree Gnome Stronghold swamp, collect toads from the ground and remove their legs; the spirit-tree network already reaches the Stronghold. Make enough three-dose potions to decant into one full four-dose bottle for Trio and a separate four-dose reserve for Making Friends with My Arm in 2.6; from zero, three herbs and three sets of legs make nine doses, enough for two four-dose bottles with one dose spare. Use a potion decanter or combine doses at the bank. Do not spend the reserved bottle on ordinary travel. The useful unlock during the quest: catch stackable karambwanji with the small net at the Holy Lake, take 20 to Lubufu south-east of Brimhaven, and receive a karambwan vessel. Load it with karambwanji; at 65+ Fishing, already guaranteed, fish a raw karambwan on Karamja's north-east coast. For Tamayu, cook one into a poison karambwan and grind it to poison the spear—do not eat it. His hunt then succeeds. Tinsay's burnt-jogre-bone/karambwanji sauce and Tiadeche's vessel/manual errands complete the other two branches. Return to Timfraku, then talk to Tinsay in the village to claim the 5,000 Cooking XP and the ability to cook edible karambwans. Keep a vessel for later fishing.

After obtaining the vessel, keep fishing until the quest's raw karambwan and recipe ingredients are present. Follow the quest dialogue for burning the jogre bones and making the sauce. The Agility potion above must reach four doses after decanting ; a three-dose bottle cannot pay Tamayu.

Stage the quest's household items and potato seeds before Unferth's chores; the potato patch grows while you do the other parts. route_steps.consumer_recovery: At 50 Cooking , use a chocolate bar on a whole cake to make the chocolate cake. Steal the cake from an Ardougne cake stall and buy the chocolate bar and milk from the Culinaromancer's Chest; a part-eaten cake is not the hand-in. Buy the five death runes from Aubury. Cut the log and replace shears/tinderbox at Lumbridge's general store. If the catspeak amulet was lost, ask the Sphinx in Sophanem for another; recover a kitten from Gertrude if needed. route_steps.baseline_instruction: First search the bank for a death talisman/tiara, catalytic talisman/tiara, or another currently valid altar-access item such as a Runecraft cape. Use one if you already own it. Guardians of the Rift access is not a guaranteed catalytic-talisman drop. If the bank has none, Thorgel's 50-item exchange is the mandatory deterministic Ironman fallback. His list is 47 fixed items plus one randomly selected ticket, one book and one key. Audit the fixed items before entering; Thorgel tells you which variant of each final three he wants. Bring them in multiple bank trips, not one impossible inventory. See the current altar section. 47 fixed items: Babydragon bones, ball of wool, bronze bar, bronze med helm, bucket of milk, cake tin, cheese, chisel. Cooked meat, egg, facemask, fishing rod, flax, gold ring, hammer, iron axe, iron nails, iron pickaxe. Jug of wine, kebab, knife, leather boots, leather gloves, lobster pot, lockpick, necklace mould, needle, oak logs. Pie dish, plank, pot of flour, potato cactus, potatoes(10) sack, pure essence, redberries, rope. Rotten tomato, shears, skull, spade, swamp paste, thread, tinderbox, unicorn horn dust, vial of water, white apron, white berries. Three assigned variants: one of archery ticket / new Agility arena ticket / Castle wars ticket; one of crumbling tome / slashed or battered book / Prifddinas' history; and one of jail key / dusty key / Witch's House door key. The books are recoverable from a POH bookcase; obtain only the ticket and key Thorgel actually assigns. An archery ticket comes from the Ranging Guild target range, a new Agility arena ticket from tagging a Brimhaven dispenser, or a Castle Wars ticket from that minigame. The jail key drops from the Taverley Dungeon jailer; the dusty key can be bought at the Legends' Guild or obtained from Velrak; Witch's House door key is under its front-door pot. For awkward fixed supplies, baby blue dragons in Taverley Dungeon provide babydragon bones, the Kalphite Lair has a potato-cactus ground spawn (bring rope and antipoison), and white berries grow around Isafdar. Check the bank before making any of these trips. The current quest guide has exact directions.
route_steps.consumer_recovery: Collect one of each fixed item, unnoted. The exceptions in appearance are still one hand-in: one iron nail and one full potatoes(10) sack , not ten loose potatoes. Check the list against your bank and obtain only the missing entries. Set aside the ingredients you still need for other quests or potions. Missing entries Where to get them Ball of wool; bronze bar; gold ring Buy wool from Aemad in East Ardougne , or shear/spin at Lumbridge. Buy copper/tin/gold ore from Ordan ; smelt copper + tin into the bronze bar and gold ore into a gold bar. At 5 Crafting , use the gold bar and Dommik's ring mould at a furnace for the plain gold ring. Bronze med helm; iron axe; iron pickaxe; iron nail Peksa in Barbarian Village sells the helm, Bob in Lumbridge the axe, and Nurmof in the Dwarven Mine the pickaxe. Smith one iron bar into iron nails at 19 Smithing ; hand in one nail and keep the extras. Bucket of milk; cheese; egg; pot of flour; cake tin; cooked meat Buy the first four at the Culinaromancer's Chest . Buy a cake tin from a charter-ship trader . Kill a cow and cook one raw beef successfully for cooked meat; cooked chicken is a different item. Chisel; hammer; needle; thread; shears; tinderbox; knife; spade Lumbridge's general store supplies chisel/hammer/shears/tinderbox. Dommik in Al Kharid sells needle/thread. A knife spawns in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen and a spade at the Falador estate agent . Facemask; fishing rod; lobster pot; necklace mould; rope; lockpick A Slayer master sells the facemask; Gerrant in Port Sarim sells the ordinary fishing rod and lobster pot; Dommik sells the mould; Ned in Draynor sells rope. Martin Thwait in the Rogues' Den sells lockpicks once 50 Agility/Thieving are met, as they are here. Leather boots; leather gloves; white apron Buy the boots and apron from Thessalia's Varrock clothes shop . Pick up leather gloves in Father Urhney's house in Lumbridge Swamp . Jug of wine; kebab; redberries; rotten tomato Fortunato in Draynor sells wine; Karim in Al Kharid sells kebabs. Pick redberries south-east of Varrock. Buy a rotten tomato from the crate by Varrock's pillory . Flax; oak logs; plank; pie dish; potatoes(10) Pick flax in the Seers' Village flax field and chop one oak log. For the ordinary plank, cut a normal log and pay a sawmill 100 coins . Make/fire a pie dish from one soft clay at Rimmington pottery, 7 Crafting . Buy an empty sack from Sarah's Farming shop south of Falador , pick ten potatoes in Lumbridge's field, and fill the sack. Pure essence; swamp paste; vial of water Ask Aubury to teleport you to the essence mine and mine one pure essence (30 Mining; already exceeded). Buy paste from the Port Khazard general store and a vial of water from Jatix in Taverley . Babydragon bones; potato cactus Kill a baby blue dragon in Taverley Dungeon ; take a dusty key and anti-dragon shield for the surrounding dragon area. Pick up the potato cactus in the Kalphite Lair ; take rope for its entrance and antipoison for the trip. Skull; unicorn horn dust; white berries Pick up a skull near Shayzien's graveyard dungeon entrance . Kill a unicorn south of Edgeville/near Barbarian Village and crush its horn with a pestle and mortar. Pick white berries in Isafdar north of the Elf Tracker, beyond the tripwire ; bring antipoison rather than using a Wilderness spawn. Assigned ticket: for an archery ticket, pay the Ranging Guild Competition Judge and shoot the competition targets. For an Agility arena ticket , tag successive highlighted dispensers at Brimhaven; use a newly earned ticket, not a discontinued ticket or a Brimhaven voucher. For a Castle wars ticket , play completed matches until you have the requested ticket. Only do the activity named on Thorgel's list. Assigned book: the crumbling tome is on the table in the building at the Barrows entrance; Prifddinas' history is in Lletya's bookcases near Arianwyn. For the battered/slashed book , search the east bookcase in the Seers' Village house with a cooking range, south of the anvils. Match the form Thorgel lists; using a knife on the battered book makes the slashed book and its key. You do not need to complete a new quest for this hand-in. Assigned key: kill the Taverley Dungeon jailer for the jail key, use it to reach Velrak and ask for the dusty key if that is the assigned one, or take the Witch's House door key from under its front-door plant pot . Keep the other travelling supplies separate from any item already handed to Thorgel.

route_steps.title: Solve the Temple of Light and complete Mourning's End Part II
required_items: Full six-piece mourner outfit including gas mask
Death Altar access: owned death/catalytic talisman/tiara OR Thorgel's 50-item exchange
New key, journal, crystal and mirrors are quest-local
route_steps.baseline_instruction: Take full mourner gear, chisel, rope, food, Prayer restores, teleports and bank access; energy or stamina support is useful. Actual 70 Agility reduces obstacle trouble, while 70 Prayer plus Protect from Melee protects against the Temple's aggressive shadows. Start with Arianwyn in Lletya, enter the HQ in disguise, take Essyllt's new key, then reach the Temple through the dark-beast tunnels. Collect the journal and blackened crystal; chisel the crystal and have Arianwyn turn it into the newly made crystal needed at the end. The light puzzle has multiple sections: hand mirrors turn beams between pillars, coloured crystals change beams, and correctly coloured beams open doors to more mirrors, crystals and chests. Keep the mirrors/crystals you have collected and the newly made crystal; puzzle mirrors and crystals cannot be banked. Allow several free inventory slots early and up to roughly 13 near the last section. You can leave and regear between sections—the puzzle state persists—but follow the guide's cyan-door mirror position before teleporting out for Thorgel bank trips, or you can lock yourself out of the short return path. If using the 50-item route, give Thorgel his requested items over multiple trips, obtain the death talisman, return with the newly made crystal, and complete the altar sequence. If you brought a valid talisman, skip the exchange. Finish the quest and bank the mourner gear for Song. Use the mirror-by-mirror guide for placements; this route gives the preparation and safe stopping points, not a second diagram.
route_steps.consumer_recovery: Use the MEP1 recovery if the full mourner outfit has been lost. Lumbridge's general store sells a chisel, Ned sells a new rope, and the potion supply note covers new prayer/energy doses if earlier elf trips used them. The new key, journal, mirrors, coloured crystals and final crystal are obtained during this quest . Keep them while following the current puzzle sequence. To enter the Death Altar, bring a suitable access item. If you have none, finish the Thorgel collection rather than waiting for an optional Guardians of the Rift reward.

required_items: Steel full helm, platebody and platelegs: 10 steel bars if crafting
Full six-piece mourner outfit including gas mask
1 irit leaf OR accepted flower; mixed flowers from the shop are accepted
1 wine of Zamorak OR Zamorak brew of any dose
1 seed dibber unless Barbarian Farming is unlocked
Elder cadantine and crystal dust are quest-local; Seren supplies have a separate consumer note
route_steps.baseline_instruction: Ardougne disguise: steel full helm, steel platebody, steel platelegs, red dye, purple dye and one silk. Mourner phase: the full retained mourner set including gas mask (plague jacket/trousers do not work), plus a tinderbox. Waterfall offerings: rope, nature rune, flowers grown from mithril/adamant seeds or one irit leaf, an adamant chainbody (consumed), wine of Zamorak or a Zamorak brew(4), cabbage (can be picked during the quest), and a black knife or black dagger. Lletya/Prif preparation: one cadantine seed, seed dibber unless the relevant Barbarian Farming step is complete, runite bar, vial of water, pestle and mortar, hammer, pickaxe, then eight limestone bricks, saw, axe and spade. Lay these out by phase; you do not need every item in one inventory. This is the current required-item list, not an assumption that a bank already contains the odd pieces. Ironman sourcing: if no runite bar is banked, buy unnoted rune platelegs from Scavvo's Rune Store in the Champions' Guild for 64,000 coins, place them in the nice nest atop Aldarin windmill, log out or hop, then search the nest for one runite bar; no 85 Smithing or rare drop is needed. Check bank and Farming Guild seed vault for the cadantine seed first; if absent, use repeatable Master Farmer pickpockets (38 Thieving gate already cleared) or continue Farming Contracts/seed packs until one appears. Those are RNG sources, so do not promise a fixed number of attempts. Buy the adamant chainbody at Wayne's Chains in southern Falador and the eight limestone bricks from Keldagrim's Stonemason. Ordinary armour shops cover steel pieces; Lletya's Seamstress or Aggie supplies dyes, and red plus blue makes purple. For the offerings, a banked irit leaf is simpler than growing flowers; telegrab a wine of Zamorak from the non-Wilderness Asgarnia Chaos Temple if necessary; buy a black dagger at Varrock Swordshop if neither accepted black blade is banked. Check all items before the first story phase.
route_steps.consumer_recovery: For the steel disguise, smith ten new steel bars into a full helm (2 bars), platebody (5) and platelegs (3) at an anvil; all recipes fit the required unboosted 70 Smithing. Smelt Ordan's iron ore and coal at one iron + two coal per bar . Reuse your animated-armour set from the defender grind if all three pieces are still banked; make only any missing pieces. Buy the silk from the Al Kharid silk trader, and red and blue dyes from Oronwen in Lletya ; mix red + blue for purple and keep a separate red dye . If there is no irit, buy mixed flowers from the Flower Girl in Miscellania ; they are an accepted flower offering, so no seed-growing wait is needed. Buy the nature rune and the law rune for Telekinetic Grab at the Wizards' Guild, plus one air rune for the wine trip. Grab the wine from the non-Wilderness Chaos Temple north of Falador ; bring food/teleport for the monks. Buy a seed dibber from Sarah's Farming shop, a vial of water and pestle and mortar from Jatix, hammer/tinderbox from Lumbridge's general store, saw from a sawmill, axe from Bob, pickaxe from Nurmof and rope from Ned; the Falador estate agent has a spade spawn. Take the cabbage found during the Waterfall section. The MEP1 recovery note supplies any missing mourner disguise pieces. The quest provides the elder cadantine and crystal-dust/inversion-potion sequence after you plant the one cadantine seed. Have the cadantine seed and runite bar ready before starting; ordinary cadantine herbs do not replace the quest plant.

route_steps.title: Prepare Iban, phoenix necklaces and stackable nightshade for Seren
required_items: Upgraded Iban's staff with enough actual charges
5 fire +1death rune per Iban Blast cast
15–20 phoenix necklaces as a planning range: each cutdiamond+goldbar+necklacemould at56Crafting, then1cosmic+10earth at57Magic
20+ stackable nightshade as a planning range; belladonna63Farming
route_steps.baseline_instruction: The default no-brews setup is upgraded Iban's staff with Iban Blast on the standard spellbook (50 Magic; five fire runes and one death rune per cast), around 15–20 phoenix necklaces, 20+ stackable nightshade, 2–4 Prayer potions, 1–2 multi-heal food options such as Guthix rest or strawberry baskets, and 50+ throwing knives or chinchompas for the 1-HP healing pillars. If neither projectile is banked, smith 10 iron bars into 50 iron knives at 22 Smithing; do not rely on an optional chinchompa catch. Bring enough Iban charges and runes for repeated attempts, an emergency teleport, and Magic-accuracy gear (roughly +50 Magic attack if your level/gear is modest). These are preparation ranges from the current low-level strategy, not a required 20-necklace grind if a smaller stock works for you. Necklaces: check banked diamonds and existing phoenix necklaces first. At 56 Crafting, use a diamond, gold bar and necklace mould on a furnace; at 57 Magic, Lvl-4 Enchant each diamond necklace with one cosmic and ten earth runes. If short on diamonds, mine repeatable Shilo Village gem rocks (already unlocked) or spend banked Shooting Star stardust on 40-gem bags at 300 stardust each. Diamond yield is random; gather only the measured shortfall. Nightshade: check bank and seed vault for belladonna seeds and plant them early at the Draynor Manor or Auburnvale belladonna patch; actual 70 Farming clears its 63 gate. Harvest with gloves. One crop gives 6–18 stackable nightshade, so two good harvests may cover 20, but check the actual yield and replant if short. If no seed is banked, catch nature implings (58 Hunter, already cleared; their jars can contain belladonna seed) or repeat Master Farmer pickpockets / Farming Contracts until one appears. None is guaranteed from prior play. Free cave nightshade is an emergency fallback, but it is unstackable and displaces necklace/restore slots. Nightshade reference.
route_steps.consumer_recovery: Check gold and enchantment runes as well: buy gold ore from Ordan , smelt one gold bar per missing diamond necklace, and buy a necklace mould from Dommik . Baba Yaga sells cosmics, and an elemental rune shop supplies the ten earth runes per enchantment . The finished item is a phoenix necklace ; do not bring an unenchanted diamond necklace into the boss inventory. Buy death and fire runes from Aubury , and check the upgraded Iban's staff's remaining charges before each attempt. Recharge at the Flames of Zamorak well in the Underground Pass , or pay the Dark Mage outside the Pass for the missing charges if you prefer his service. Refill prayer potions from current herbs and snape grass. Make Guthix rest using the One Small Favour tea recipe ; buy/gather its herbs again if they were consumed. For missing belladonna seeds, the Puro-Puro equipment and nature-impling method also works for this drop. Plant only enough crops to meet the remaining stackable-nightshade requirement , with gloves to harvest. Cave nightshade takes one inventory slot per item, so use the farmed version for this setup when possible.

route_steps.title: Complete Song of the Elves; unlock Prifddinas
required_items: Steel full helm, platebody and platelegs: 10 steel bars if crafting
Full six-piece mourner outfit including gas mask
1 irit leaf OR accepted flower; mixed flowers from the shop are accepted
1 wine of Zamorak OR Zamorak brew of any dose
1 seed dibber unless Barbarian Farming is unlocked
Elder cadantine and crystal dust are quest-local; Seren supplies have a separate consumer note
route_steps.baseline_instruction: Start with Arianwyn in Lletya, then follow the Ardougne/Edmond and Elena story using the steel knight disguise. Move through the West Ardougne rebellion in mourner gear and the Waterfall Dungeon's six-offering pillar puzzle. Bank between these phases; do not drag all quest items through every fight. In the Lletya/Prif preparation, plant the cadantine seed, use the runite bar and hammer on the elderly elf's exoskeleton, and make the inversion potion with the elder cadantine and crystal dust. The Grand Library and city preparation lead into hostile combat. Full quest guide. For the Arianwyn fight, take sensible food/restores and Ranged or Melee gear; move off his orange ground attacks and watch the purple attack that disables Prayer. Regear before the Underground Pass siege and Essyllt: multiple enemies make Prayer, food and supply management important. The quest moves toward Seren after the siege; you can teleport out after the transition/cutscene to bank and build the dedicated Seren inventory rather than force the boss with leftover siege supplies. The phase guide gives exact dialogue and puzzle clicks. Unsafe-death storage: items lost during Song's major instanced fights can be reclaimed from the Rebel Scout for 80,000 coins (the fee may come from your bank). For Seren, the Scout appears outside the boss entrance. Reclaim items before dying anywhere else; another unsafe death while the Scout still holds them can delete that stash. Do not use a new fight as a recovery shortcut. Current retrieval rule. Understand Seren's repeat: keep Protect from Missiles up for normal projectiles (their max drops to 3+3); on her first special she teleports you beside her, so step away before the rapid melee hits. On the second, attack the lighter-coloured real clone. On the third, rapidly tag each red 1-HP healing pillar with knives/chins so she cannot heal through your Iban damage. Between specials, cast Iban Blast and maintain Prayer/charges. Her fourth special teleports you in front of her and queues a hit for almost your maximum HP. Let normal damage bring you to a controlled low HP early (the Wiki suggests about 30–40 HP initially), then after the fourth teleport, equip a fresh phoenix necklace and right-click Eat the stackable nightshade during the attack wind-up, before the hitsplat. Nightshade self-damage must carry you from above to at or below 20% of maximum HP to trigger the necklace. That activation clears the queued near-max hit even though its animation finishes, and the necklace then heals about 30% maximum HP. At 20+ current HP nightshade deals 15, so aim around 20% of maximum HP plus 10–15 HP; keep enough margin to survive normal attacks and heal if you drift outside that window. Practice the timing against the Wiki animation/strategy; heal, restore Prayer and use another necklace for the next cycle. Teleport out if supplies or timing are not safe. Blood Blitz, brews or a better powered staff can simplify the fight if already owned, but none is a Chapter 2 dependency. After the Fragment, follow the final dialogue and finish Song of the Elves completely—do not stop at the boss kill. Claim four quest points and 40,000 XP in each of the eight required skills, plus Prifddinas, its port/crystal-city travel and access to the Gauntlet, Zalcano and elven dungeon/resources as unlocks, not tasks to begin here. Record rewards against the live skill tab rather than projecting exact post-quest levels.
route_steps.consumer_recovery: Before starting a story phase, use the complete quest kit and recovery note . Before Seren or a retry, use the separate Seren supply check so earlier siege food, spent necklaces and consumed doses are replaced. The quest's local crystal, seed and potion items come from its dialogue and collection steps; keep them until the quest asks you to use them.

additional_quests.consumer_recovery: If you prefer moving around to bankstanding, visit Ranulph in north-west Auburn Valley, Varlamore (fairy ring AIS is one route). The short Vale Totems miniquest requires Children of the Sun and 20 Fletching and teaches the activity. For the miniquest itself, cut five oak logs and use a knife to fletch four into oak shortbows (u); keep the fifth as a log. That supplies the one oak log and four matching oak items needed to build and decorate the taught totem. A knife spawns in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen if missing. After the miniquest, repeat with one log and four matching-wood fletched items per totem. Ent visits generate offerings and research points for rewards; totems eventually need rebuilding. Maple totems open at 50 Fletching. It is more active than the relaxed Make-X default and supplies no mandatory item. Full totem primer.
